briefdescription.para: This file contains several declarations for the debuginfod client and server.

detaileddescription.para: The client functions are getDefaultDebuginfodUrls, getCachedOrDownloadArtifact, and several convenience functions for specific artifact types: getCachedOrDownloadSource, getCachedOrDownloadExecutable, and getCachedOrDownloadDebuginfo. For the server, this file declares the DebuginfodLogEntry and DebuginfodServer structs, as well as the DebuginfodLog, DebuginfodCollection classes.
